description:
This bright and spacious three-bedroom terraced home is ideally positioned within the popular and well-established Grange Village development in Mullingar. Offering generous accommodation, a newly fitted kitchen and excellent outdoor storage, the property represents an attractive opportunity for first-time buyers, young families or investors seeking a conveniently located home within easy reach of Mullingar town centre.
The accommodation begins with a welcoming entrance hall leading to a comfortable living room complete with tiled flooring. To the rear, is the spacious kitchen and dining area with a fitted kitchen and provides ample room for both cooking and dining. A rear access door leads directly to the yard, while a convenient guest WC completes the ground-floor accommodation.
Upstairs, there are three well-proportioned bedrooms, all finished with laminate flooring, with two bedrooms also benefiting from wardrobe storage. The main family bathroom is fully tiled and fitted with a shower suite, WC, wash hand basin and heated towel rail.
Externally, the property comes with parking to the front, while to the rear is a generous enclosed yard with a large garden shed providing excellent additional storage. 
Grange Village enjoys a highly convenient location close to a range of local shops, schools and everyday amenities, while Mullingar town centre is within walking distance. A green area and playground are also nearby, making the development particularly appealing for families. The Royal Canal and its walking routes are within easy reach, providing an excellent recreational amenity close to home.
For commuters, convenient access to the N4 and N52 provides excellent connectivity to the surrounding areas and wider road network. This property offers an excellent opportunity for first-time buyers, families or investors. Viewing is highly recommended.
